rules and faqs but couldn't find conclusive answers on these-

1) If I'm equipping/employing retainer/ally, do I show the card
BEFORE or AFTER they decide to block? My friends think that you
only show the card afterwards, but I can't find any mention of

2) If I attempt to steal more blood than a vamp has, does it go

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Greg Janson <gja...@earthlink.net> writes:

>Some simple stuff I can't figure out... I've nearly memorized the
>rules and faqs but couldn't find conclusive answers on these-

>1) If I'm equipping/employing retainer/ally, do I show the card
>BEFORE or AFTER they decide to block? My friends think that you
>only show the card afterwards, but I can't find any mention of
>this. Answers?

Before. All library cards are exposed as they are played.

>2) If I attempt to steal more blood than a vamp has, does it go
>to torpor? (I realize I only get the blood that is avail. to
>steal.)

No. Only unhealed damage can send a vampire to torpor (this includes
all aggravated damage, since aggravated damage cannot be healed by
definition). Anything else that sends a vampire to torpor will state
so explicitly on the card (Day Operation, NosPerformance Art, etc.)

In Jyhad, you lose 1.
In VtES, you lose 2.

This was one of the primary changes from Jyhad to VtES, and it was done
to simplify the proces of applying multiple batches of agg.

Under the original Jyhad rules you have it correct. But V:tES changes the
aggravated damage rules so that a 1 point agravated damage hit removes a
blood and puts the vampire in topor. This meas a pulled fangs on a
vampire with 0 blood burns the vampire. This was the single greatest
change between the Jyhad and V:tES rules. (See Advanced Combat, section 3,
Aggravated damage on page 48 of the V:tES rules).
